Initial release — rapidly automates affiliate marketing research, content, and promotion.

- Reverse-engineers top competitor affiliate sites for their traffic and conversion strategies
- Identifies low-competition keyword gaps for easier ranking
- Generates a complete content funnel: SEO articles, reviews, comparisons, and email sequences
- Produces promotional videos using InVideo AI
- Integrates Apify for data gathering and Claude AI for content and strategic analysis
